note: Sheets are single rows of equal frames. Position each so its anchor point lands on the placement x,y; sheets with anchor [0,0] are placed by their top-left corner.

folder.note: Static sill item: a thick brown-tan folder full of papers, lying flat and closed. Anchor is the bottom-centre of the near edge.

folder_place.note: The folder slides up onto the sill and lands with barely a bounce. The folder is part of these frames; show the static folder once it ends.

folder_open.note: The front cover swings up on its far edge, overshoots slightly and settles propped open, revealing the top page. Replaces the static folder while it plays; frame 0 matches the closed folder. Play backwards to close.

folder_opened.note: Static open folder: the last frame of folder_open, to show after it finishes.
